beats.text: You lost touch with a friend. Text them today!
In a series of experiments, people sent a short note to someone they hadn't talked to in a while.
First, they guessed how much it would be appreciated. Then the friends answered.
They loved it more than the senders expected!
And the more out of the blue the message was, the bigger the gap.
So send the text. Right now. It means more than you think.

sources: Liu, Rim, Min & Min (2022), The surprise of reaching out: Appreciated more than we think, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology – series of experiments with more than 5,900 participants; senders of a short note (or note + small gift) to someone they had not been in touch with consistently underestimated how much recipients appreciated it; underestimation was larger when the contact was more surprising and when the tie was weaker.
